debts.lead: Loans, financing and private debts at a glance – with amortization schedule and debt-free date.
debts.emptyText: Add loans, leases, overdrafts or private debts. The payment is planned in your budget and booked automatically on its due date.
debts.rateBelowInterest: The payment does not cover the interest – the debt is growing.
debts.strategyLead: Snowball pays off the smallest debt first (quick wins), avalanche the most expensive first (less interest). Freed-up payments roll into the next debt.
debts.strategyExtraHint: Pre-filled with your planned extra repayments.
debts.strategy.impossible: Cannot be paid off with these payments.
debt.fixedUntilSoon: The fixed-rate period ends on {0} – arrange follow-up financing in time.
debt.scheduleLead: Preview from the current month with payment, interest, principal and remaining debt.
debt.noLinked: No budget item linked – payments are only booked manually.
debt.deleteText: “{0}” and all booked payments will be deleted.
debt.deleteLinked: Also delete linked budget items (otherwise they remain as regular expenses)
debt.deletePaymentText: The payment of {1} on {0} will be deleted.
debt.method.linear: Forecast based on the average of recent repayments (no fixed payment set).
debt.method.annuity: Forecast based on payment, interest rate and planned extra repayments.
debt.reason.no-payment: No payment planned – set a payment or book payments.
debt.reason.rate-below-interest: The payment does not cover the interest.
debt.reason.too-long: Repayment would take longer than 50 years.
debt.name: Name
debt.originalHint: For the progress bar: how large was the debt at the beginning?
debt.openingHint: Remaining debt on this date – later payments are deducted from it.
debt.durationAtRate: Paid off in {0} at this payment.
debt.rateTooLow: The payment does not cover the interest (interest: {0} per month).
debt.inBudget: Plan payment as a budget expense
debt.inBudgetHint: The payment appears in your budget and cash flow and is booked automatically on its due date.
debt.extraHint: Optional. Planned as a separate budget item and speeds up repayment.
debt.paymentInBudget: Book as an expense in the budget
debt.paymentInBudgetHint: If unchecked, only the remaining debt is reduced (e.g. when paid from a buffer).
debt.paymentAutoHint: Payments from linked budget items are booked automatically – only record additional payments here.
debt.paymentExceeds: The amount is higher than the remaining debt ({0}).
err.debt.interest: The interest rate must be between 0 and 100%.
